notes.title: Now Available - A Stroke of Fate: Operation Valkyrie
notes.content:
A Stroke of Fate: Operation Valkyrie is now available on Steam!

In this detective adventure game, control Standartenfuhrer Gerhard Mayer, a patriot who works in the Reich Security Head Office, as he does everything in his power to help the Resistance to overthrow the Nazi regime and stop the war.
